main_text.p: dis diligentior esse potest, constitutus prom-ptos tenet, voluntati locum interuisentium obsecuturus, & desiderio, curiositatique responsurus. Nullus hinc excluditur, nulli prohibetur aditus, nullius conatus interrum-pitur. Tanta est in adiuuandis literatorum studijs summi Pontificis munificentia. Non credis? Rogita tuos omnes, etiam ex Re-formata religione, qui Romam venere, a quibus plane disces & humanitatem, qua excepti sunt, & promptitudinem in porri-gendis voluminibus, & obsequia in mini-strando, & solicitudinem, vt eis ex senten-tia satis sint. Longum tibi catalogum texe-rem, si eorum nomina animus esset referre. Improbe igitur perniciem causæ Deforma-tæ, Reformatæ volui dicere, Religionis de-ploras. Porro illud quoque velim animad-uertas, ex Palatinis illis Codicibus multa erbi[?] literato obtrusse, quæ tua sunt, illorum Codicum nullum unquam usum Allatio fu-isse. Nihil enim in illis est alicuius momenti, quod non in Vaticana melius, & speciosius eniteat. Et vt securius posthac verba profun-das, & cesses dare sonum sine mente: si Heidelbergensis cum Romana comparetur, Heidelbergensis nulla prorsus iudicabitur. page.notes: The strip of cut-off letters along the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. "erbi[?]" is the first word of the italic phrase after "multa"; its first letters are not clearly legible, so the reading is doubtful. "disces" and "usum" are read from the scan with the u/v rule applied. No running head is printed. The text runs on across the page, with no clear indent before any line, so it is one paragraph continued from the previous page.
